DECISION: ACCEPT
RISK: medium
SURFACES: ui

## Title
Show stock level on the product page

## Summary
Shoppers cannot see whether an item is in stock.

## Scope
Show the remaining stock count on the product page of the storefront.
Hide it when the count is above 50.

## Acceptance criteria
1. The product page shows "Only N left" when stock is 50 or fewer.
2. The product page shows nothing about stock above 50.

## Out of scope
- Changing the stock sync job.
- Admin views.

## Questions
1. Should reserved stock count?
